title: MNI Open iEEG Atlas: high-sampling-rate NREM sleep sEEG (normal high-frequency oscillations)
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from 71 patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy during non-REM (N2/N3) sleep, kept at their original sampling rates of 512, 1024 and 2000 Hz. The data come from the MNI Open iEEG Atlas and were used to establish normative values for high-frequency oscillations (ripples, fast ripples and high-frequency activity) in 17 brain regions. Only bipolar channels judged to record normal physiological activity (1152 channels) are included, with Talairach coordinates and region labels.
methods_description: Clinical stereo-EEG depth electrode recordings (DIXI or MNI homemade electrodes) were obtained at tertiary epilepsy centres. Bipolar channels with normal activity were selected outside the seizure onset zone and lesions. Roughly twenty-minute artifact-free N2/N3 sleep sections were chosen. Source int16 samples were repacked losslessly into BrainVision format with resolution equal to the source gain.
